subject: paper:safren-2005
quote: those who were randomized to CBT had lower IE-rated ADHD symptoms (p < .01) and global severity (p < .002), as well as self-reported ADHD symptoms (p < .0001) than those randomized to continued psychopharmacology alone.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract (efetch); IE = independent evaluator. RCT evidence that skills-based CBT reduces ADHD symptoms beyond medication alone.

subject: paper:kreider-2019
quote: Students with LD/ADHD must work longer and harder than peers, which makes managing time and productivity a critical skill for school success.
rationale: Verbatim from the open-access abstract. Names the effort cost — compensation means working harder than peers just to keep pace.

subject: paper:kreider-2019
quote: Strategies classified as habit and routine use, reframing, and symptom-specific strategies were identified.
rationale: Verbatim from the abstract. A taxonomy of the coping strategies adults with ADHD/LD actually use — habit/routine, reframing, symptom-specific.

subject: paper:wettstein-2026
quote: A linear mixed model revealed no significant treatment or treatment-by-time effects for the total AAQoL or its subdomains.
rationale: Verbatim from the open-access PLOS ONE abstract. Long-term follow-up found no added quality-of-life benefit from coping-focused CBT — the uneven-payoff side of the ledger.
